title: NDC[X] certification runs — 2026-10-18 (test host nodea1, sales point AdenisPDV)
host: test host nodea1, sales point AdenisPDV, office NCEPF3273
intro: Live runs executed with `ndcx_cert_runner.js` against the Amadeus test host (AA), driving the product's own builders/mappers; raw XML written by the capture logger into `api-aerial/use cases/NDCX/`. Each case folder holds the calls in order, RQ+RS per step, copied unmodified. Windows are in the operator machine's local time (the logger stamps file mtimes locally).

cases.title: Case 1 — 2 ADT / domestic / one way / direct flights / cash / booking and ticketing
notes: JFK-ORD AA3162, 2026-12-07, one way, direct, 2 ADT — US domestic on the certification carrier (AA).
`04-retrieve-held` is the pay command's pre-payment retrieve (the pay amount comes from the live order): the order exists, no `TicketDocInfos` yet.
`06-retrieve-ticketed`: the two tickets appear with coupons `O` after `Travel_OrderPay` — no separate ticketing call on the NDC path.
Last case that had no clean live run with its exact composition; ticked on `offerPay` capability before, now proven end to end.

cases.title: Case 2 — 2 ADT + 1 CHD(CNN) + 1 INF / international / round trip / DIRECT / upsell at pricing / credit card / booking and ticketing
notes: CDG-JFK AA43 / JFK-CDG AA42, direct both ways, 2026-12-07 / 2026-12-14.

`03-offer-price-upsell` is the Offer_06 evidence: `Request/ShoppingCriteria/FarePreferences @PreferencesContext="Upsell"` answered with 9 `OtherOffers/Offer` bundles (Main Cabin 1947.82 → Flagship Business 14713.82 EUR) and an updated `ShoppingResponseID` (P950A6E5-268C-4DF5-A2BB).

`05-order-create` is the Create_05 evidence: `SelectedOffer/OfferID` is an `OtherOffers` offer (`…P555BA8FF-…-2`), `ShoppingResponseRefID` is that updated shopping response, one SelectedOfferItem per PTC (ADT, ADT, CNN, INF).

`04-order-create-failed-pax-name` is the first attempt, refused by the host with `39138 FAIL TO CREATE PAX NAME IN 1A PNR` when the pax list carried a different surname per passenger; the retry uses one shared family surname with distinct given names/titles (MR JEAN / MRS MARIE / MSTR LUC / MISS EVA).

cases.title: Case 3 + 5 — 2 ADT + 1 CHD(CNN) + 1 INF / international / round trip / CONNECTING / credit card / booking and ticketing / same-day VOID after ticketing

summary.outcome: TICKETED then VOIDED same day (16 coupons -> V)

notes: CDG-DFW-LAX AA49/AA1526 out and LAX-JFK-CDG AA307/AA42 back — two segments per bound, US hub connections (the FR↔US connecting itinerary the certification Void/Refund template asks for).
`08-void-quote-reshop`: `Travel_OrderReshop` cancel quote returns `ReshopResults UseCase="VOID"` (`DescText VOID`), refund 0 — the Cancel_02 evidence for the void branch.

`09-order-cancel-void`: `Travel_OrderCancel` voids all 16 coupons (`CouponInfo/Status=V` on 4 tickets × 4 segments); the post-cancel retrieve answers 119 UNABLE TO RETRIEVE PNR, which is the expected terminal state.

Same-day void on AA does work when the quote is taken first — the 2026-10-13 attempt on this office (cancel straight after issuance, no quote) failed with `UNABLE TO RETRIEVE OFFER` / `RS_ERROR_UNKNOWN`.

cases.title: Case 4 — 2 ADT + 1 CHD(CNN) + 1 INF / international / round trip / direct / credit card selected / HELD then CANCELLED before ticketing

summary.payment: credit card VI on file (never charged)
summary.outcome: HELD then CANCELLED before ticketing (order unretrievable, 119)

notes: No `Travel_OrderPay`, so the order is never ticketed: `04-retrieve-held` shows the order with an empty `TicketDocInfos`.

`05-order-cancel-before-ticketing` is a bare `Travel_OrderCancel` (OrderID + OwnerCode, no reshop quote) — the held-order branch of the product's cancel path (`pnr.status = 1` ⇒ outcome `CANCEL`); the reply is a clean `Response/OrderRefID`, and the final retrieve answers 119.

**2 ADT + 1 CHD + 1 INF / international / RT / direct / upsell at pricing / credit card** → `C2-direct-upsell-card` (Offer_06 on `03-`, Create_05 on `05-`).
